name: Shadowhunt Shell
description:
When this card is added to your Hand: If your active character is Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo, convert this card to the corresponding element.
When this card is played or you Discard it from your Hand: Prioritize dealing 1 Anemo DMG to the opponent's active character, then randomly add 1 Shadowhunt Shell to your deck.
